title: Mattamy's Plans for 26 Hounslow Avenue in Willowdale Scaled Back
summary: Mattamy Homes is scaling back its plans for 26 Hounslow Avenue in Willowdale, seeking a smaller building with simpler construction in North York Centre. A Minor Variance application proposes reducing the Studio JCI-designed condominium from 27 to 21 storeys. The revised design would align floor-plates to simplify the structure, a change the developer attributes to construction costs and changing market conditions.

title: Beyond the Show Suite: The Reality of Moving Into a New Condo
summary: The show suite had staged furniture, perfect lighting, and a view rendered on a sunny afternoon. Occupancy day often brings protective paper on the elevator walls, fresh paint fumes in the hallway, and a lobby with no furniture yet. Moving into a new condo in Toronto is exciting, but it rarely matches the sales centre version of the dream. Knowing what to expect, from elevator bookings to interim occupancy fees, makes the first few months far less stressful. Most of the surprises are predictable once you know where to look.

title: Misty Morn
summary:
An early day shot of the the Toronto skyline from a Dufferin and Dupont balcony catches a mist lifting from the well-treed, mostly low-rise neighbourhoods to the west of Downtown, our taller towers making up the jagged, half-hidden horizon behind.
